limitations: This is the actual final 0770 source's own accepted Pages evidence. No measurements from the preceding 79b5 or 8020 source replace these final raw arrays.

All 32 numeric windows pass the original strict thresholds. In particular full desktop map-pan p95 is 34.800000000046566 ms, below 35 without rounding; this does not establish extra headroom beyond the measured run.

The final runner uses AMD EPYC 9V74; accepted 79b5 used EPYC 9V45 and failed f0c4 used EPYC 7763. These runs are not a controlled performance A/B comparison and no causal speedup magnitude is claimed.
The previous f0c4 full desktop map-pan value of exactly 35 ms remains an explicit original failure, unaffected by this final-source pass.

This recovery independently validates accepted artifact identity and complete original raw JSON. Fresh independent decoding of the separate final design PNG bytes is outside this review; original CI validators remain recorded separately.
No new trace, browser run, acceptance measurement, repeated performance gate, main/ref mutation or release publication was performed by this review.
